units.text: EXT. DEAD DRIVE-IN THEATER - NIGHT
A cracked lot.
A blank screen the size of a barn.
Speaker poles stand in rows like headstones.
One lamp burns over a concession shack.
PELL PELLEGRINO, 50s, in a loud tie and a camel coat, sits on the hood of a Buick with a briefcase on his knee.
ODESSA LANE, 40, a plainclothes detective in a gray raincoat, walks across the gravel with her hands visible.
You're early.
units.name: ODESSA

units.text: I like to see who comes.
units.name: PELL

units.text: Just me.
units.name: ODESSA

units.text: Just you. Nice of them.
units.name: PELL

units.text: You asked for me.
units.name: ODESSA

units.text: I asked for the one who wouldn't bring a van.
units.name: PELL

units.text: Odessa stops ten feet away.
She lowers her hands, one of them drifting to the lining of her coat.
Pell opens the briefcase an inch and looks inside, then up.
A moth circles the lamp, crashing, crashing.
Down the lot, a dog barks twice and gives up.
Pell slaps the case shut, hops off the hood, and takes a step, and Odessa takes a step, and the gravel cracks under both of them.
You know what this lot used to show?
units.name: PELL

units.text: Westerns.
units.name: ODESSA

units.text: Every Friday. My father brought me. Dust, horses, a man in a hat who always knew the way out.
units.name: PELL

units.text: Pell.
units.name: ODESSA

units.text: He never did. Know the way. He just had the hat.
units.name: PELL

units.text: Where's Sal?
units.name: ODESSA

units.text: Sal's on the snack bar roof. With a rifle.
units.name: PELL

units.text: She doesn't look up.
She keeps her eyes on his.
You're telling me.
units.name: ODESSA

units.text: I'm telling you because I like you.
units.name: PELL

units.text: That's not why.
units.name: ODESSA

units.text: No. I'm telling you because you'll understand it's an insult.
units.name: PELL

units.text: He won't shoot.
units.name: ODESSA

units.text: He would. But I'd like to make you an offer first.
units.name: PELL

units.text: Go on.
units.name: ODESSA

units.text: I'll give you the briefcase. All of it. Names, dates, drops, three judges, and the mayor's cousin. In return, tonight, you go home. You never found me.
units.name: PELL

units.text: That's a lot of names for a woman who can't be trusted.
units.name: ODESSA

units.text: You're the only one who can't be bought. That's the point.
units.name: PELL

units.text: She looks at the roof of the snack bar.
A silhouette, a barrel.
She looks back.
Put it on the ground.
units.name: ODESSA

units.text: Detective.
units.name: PELL

units.text: Put it on the ground, Mr. Pellegrino, and tell your friend to climb down.
units.name: ODESSA

units.text: Pell holds the briefcase for a long beat.
Then he lowers it to the gravel.
The lamp flickers.
On the snack bar roof, the silhouette does not move.
